snippet.title: Little Lights Remain Trailer
snippet.description:
🌟 Live the Magic and the Adventure! 🌟
Little Lights Remains is an epic and heartwarming journey through a world lost in shadows.

✨ Explore a Mystical Realm
Embark on a magical adventure filled with ancient secrets, brave heroes, and mysterious creatures. Restore the light, protect the innocent, and face the darkness that threatens all life.

🛡️ Epic Tower Defense Meets Immersive Storytelling
Strategic battles, emotional moments, and stunning environments await you in this unique fusion of genres.

🎮 Try the Free Demo — Coming Soon!
Get ready to experience a first taste of the world of Little Lights Remains. The free demo will be available soon!

🧭 Wishlist Now on Steam!
Help us spread the light — add Little Lights Remains to your wishlist and be part of the adventure from the very beginning.
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3117730/Little_Lights_Remains_TD/

🌈 Follow Our Journey
Be part of the Another Path Studios community and stay up to date with our progress, behind-the-scenes content, and magical surprises!

🔔 Subscribe, like, and share the light!

#LittleLightsRemains #IndieGame #SteamWishlist #AdventureGame #TowerDefense #AnotherPathStudios #indiedev
